mission_link: The v35 citation-heritage fairness audit (ACCEPTED, run 38039706350) FALSIFIED dense-superiority over the TF-IDF *citation* representation but left one surviving product role: 'dense embeddings are justified only as a TEXT-ONLY proxy for citation heritage when citation metadata is absent/unresolved (user-imported corpora)'. That role has NEVER been tested against the correct comparator (a text-only baseline the product can build without a citation graph). The product's second input mode is user-imported corpora, which typically have no resolved citation graph, so this proxy is the ONLY remaining executable path for a citation-heritage map mode. The evaluation lane's frozen dense complementary criterion (citation_heritage_view: AUC>=0.75 on shared>=2 pairs; TF-IDF comparator 0.7296) also conflicts with the v35 matched-pair numbers (dense_cp64 0.7189 vs cited_decisions_tfidf 0.7159 on identical no-self ORIG pairs). This cycle tests the surviving role and reconciles the criterion.
question: For a corpus WITHOUT a resolved citation graph, are dense text embeddings a necessary-and-sufficient citation-heritage proxy - i.e. do they beat the strongest text-only baseline (the best representation the product could build from text alone) by a decisive margin on identical matched self-pair-free citation-relatedness pairs? And is the evaluation lane's frozen shared>=2 / AUC>=0.75 dense criterion a valid capability gate?

hypotheses_preregistered.H1_dense_proxy_sufficiency_ORIG: On identical matched self-pair-free ORIG pairs, dense_cp64 beats the best TEXT-ONLY representation (max over full_text_tfidf_light, regeste_tfidf, regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.5, regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.7) by >= +0.05 AUC.
hypotheses_preregistered.H1b_dense_proxy_sufficiency_DIRECT: Same comparison on the DIRECT citation relation (A cites B) with hard (non-citation-related) negatives, restricted to the identical dense-covered pair set, margin >= +0.05 AUC.
hypotheses_preregistered.H2_eval_criterion_degenerate: The evaluation lane's frozen dense citation-heritage criterion 'AUC>=0.75 on shared>=2 citation pairs' is relation-degenerate: a faithful citation representation (full-dim binary citation Jaccard) scores >=0.99 on SHARED2 and dense_cp64 scores >=0.90 on SHARED2, while dense_cp64 on the DIRECT relation is <0.75. A flat SHARED2 threshold therefore cannot certify the product capability.
hypotheses_preregistered.H3_baseline_reconciliation: The evaluation lane's frozen comparator 0.7296 is a with-self, mixed-relation ORIG number on a 1000-pos / 2000-neg sample; on the identical matched self-pair-free ORIG pairs the same cited_decisions_tfidf representation is materially lower (~0.7159), so 'dense >= 0.75' and 'TF-IDF = 0.7296' are not comparable quantities. Recompute and report both protocols.

threats_preregistered.T1_self_pairs: ORIG positives contain (d,d) self-pairs (174/1020) whose cosine is 1.0 for every representation; remove them for all comparisons.
threats_preregistered.T2_pair_set_mismatch: Dense checkpoints cover 2000-2023 (158,427 decisions); the full corpus metadata is 173,963 and the TF-IDF arrays are 175,440 rows. The primary comparison uses ONLY pairs where BOTH decisions have a dense checkpoint, so every representation is scored on the IDENTICAL pair list. Per-representation-filtered numbers are reported separately only for provenance.
threats_preregistered.T3_baseline_choice: The text-only baseline family is fixed in advance. To avoid a weak-baseline win, the primary baseline is the MAX over the pre-registered text-only family (the hardest text-only comparator). citation-based representations (cited_decisions_tfidf, hybrids, jaccard) are NOT eligible as text-only baselines because they cannot be built without a citation graph.
threats_preregistered.T4_corpus_fitted_encoders: Both dense and TF-IDF encoders are fitted on this corpus; this is symmetric for the proxy use case (both would be fitted on the imported corpus) and is not a dense advantage.
threats_preregistered.T5_pair_relation_heterogeneity: ORIG mixes DIRECT and SHARED relations; the relation-stratified DIRECT/SHARED analysis is reported separately so a mixed-relation average cannot hide a relation-specific failure.

text_only_family: full_text_tfidf_light (TF-IDF over truncated full_text; always available)
regeste_tfidf (TF-IDF over regeste/headnote; available if curated summary present)
fixed_representations.text_only_primary_baseline: max over text_only_family on the identical pair set
metadata_only_report_only: outcome_tfidf (outcome metadata; NOT text, reported for context only)
citation_aware_context: citation_jaccard_full (full-dim binary outgoing-citation Jaccard; faithful citation reference)

fixed_pair_sets.ORIG_MATCHED_NO_SELF: evaluation/results/174k_citation_heritage/citation_pairs_174k.json positives/negatives where BOTH decisions have a dense 2000-2023 checkpoint, minus (d,d) self-pairs. Expected n_pos=606, n_neg=834 (must match the v35 fairness audit).
fixed_pair_sets.ORIG_ALL_NO_SELF: same file, self-pairs removed, no dense filter (context only).
fixed_pair_sets.DIRECT_HARD_MATCHED: graph-derived ordered pairs (s,t), s!=t, t in graph[s], with hard negatives (no direct citation and zero shared outgoing targets), restricted to pairs where BOTH decisions are dense-covered (identical pair set for all representations).
fixed_pair_sets.SHARED1_HARD_MATCHED: unordered pairs sharing >=1 outgoing citation target, hard negatives, dense-covered.
fixed_pair_sets.SHARED2_HARD_MATCHED: unordered pairs sharing >=2 outgoing citation targets (the evaluation lane's relation), hard negatives, dense-covered.

metric: AUC-ROC via Mann-Whitney U with average ranks; cosine similarity as the decision score (TF-IDF vectors are L2-normalized but a proper cosine is always computed).

success_rules_frozen.dense_text_proxy_justified: H1 margin (dense_cp64 - max(text_only_family)) >= +0.05 AUC on ORIG_MATCHED_NO_SELF AND H1b margin >= +0.05 AUC on DIRECT_HARD_MATCHED. => product may ship a dense-based citation-heritage proxy view for imported corpora.
success_rules_frozen.dense_text_proxy_partial: exactly one of H1 / H1b passes. => ship only on the passing relation, marked exploratory.
success_rules_frozen.dense_text_proxy_not_justified: neither H1 nor H1b passes. => do NOT ship a dense-based citation-heritage view; use the best text-only TF-IDF baseline for imported corpora.
success_rules_frozen.H2_supported: citation_jaccard_full SHARED2_HARD_MATCHED AUC >= 0.99 AND dense_cp64 SHARED2_HARD_MATCHED AUC >= 0.90 AND dense_cp64 DIRECT_HARD_MATCHED AUC < 0.75.
success_rules_frozen.uncertainty: 2000-resample paired bootstrap 95% CI on the dense_cp64-minus-best-text-only AUC margin (seed 42), resampling the shared valid pair list.

decision_unlocked.if_justified: Product: add a dense-embedding citation-heritage PROXY mode for imported corpora without citations, criterion = dense_cp64 beats the best text-only baseline by >= +0.05 on DIRECT and ORIG. Evaluation lane: re-freeze the dense complementary criterion with a relation-stratified, self-pair-free, text-only-comparator rule.
decision_unlocked.if_not_justified: Product: the citation-heritage mode for imported corpora uses the best text-only TF-IDF baseline; dense is NOT shipped for citation heritage. Legal-distance: revise the surviving-role statement accordingly; no further dense-proxy cycle justified.
decision_unlocked.either_way: Reconcile the evaluation lane's frozen comparator 0.7296 (with-self, mixed-relation, 1000/2000 sample) with the identical matched self-pair-free number, and replace the flat shared>=2 / 0.75 gate with a relation-stratified criterion if H2 is supported.

data_provenance.full_metadata: evaluation/data/174k/metadata_174k.json (173,963; identical id order to evaluation/results/174k/embeddings/metadata.json; both are prefixes of the 175,440-row TF-IDF arrays)
data_provenance.citation_pairs_orig: evaluation/results/174k_citation_heritage/citation_pairs_174k.json (1020 pos / 1020 neg; direct+shared among 174 citing decisions)

note: This experiment adds ONLY text-only baselines and identical-pair matching to the FROZEN v35 pipelines; it does not overwrite any prior result artifact. It tests the one surviving dense complementary role and reconciles a cross-lane criterion. No new data is generated.
